entities.summary: "Anaconda" is a song by rapper Nicki Minaj. It was released on August 4, 2014, by Young Money, Cash Money, and Republic as the second single from her third album, The Pinkprint (2014). The song was produced by Polow da Don, DJ Spydr, and Da Internz, and prominently samples "Baby Got Back" (1992) by Sir Mix-a-Lot. The song's title comes from the sampled line "my anaconda don't want none unless you've got buns, hun". It peaked at number two on the US Billboard Hot 100, becoming Minaj's highest-charting single at the time.
